# Load the institutional correction from Skills 0.1.29

## Context
This is the Engine consumer step already planned by neomjs/neo-agent-skills#140 and graduated D#19384. Skills 0.1.29 is published with gitHead b774f9a24b21b1a7b2171441897a917e20fdfe7d, the combined source after #141/#143/#142. Engine currently declares and locks 0.1.19; the measured installed package on one seat is older still.

## The Problem
The accepted selection, premise and learning corrections remain unavailable to future Engine sessions until this consumer resolves the published package and regenerates its existing instruction entrypoint. A package source merge is not a load receipt.

## The Architectural Reality
package.json and package-lock.json own the Engine dependency. The package owns agents-md sections and the generator; AGENTS.md is generated for repo union neo + neo-agent-brain and audience maintainer, preserving the existing AiConfig read gate. .agents/skills resolves into the installed package, and .claude/CLAUDE.md links the root entrypoint. Atlas semantics remain the Engine companion neomjs/neo#19385.

## The Fix
Pin and lock neo-agent-skills 0.1.29, install it in an isolated checkout, and regenerate AGENTS.md through the package's declared generator. Preserve existing links; do not hand-edit generated instructions.

## Contract Ledger
| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dependency and lock | published 0.1.29 / Skills #140 | both resolve 0.1.29 | failed resolution is not accepted | manifest/lock/installed readback |
| AGENTS.md | package generator, neo/maintainer | byte-exact generated maintainer entrypoint for the Body+Brain scope | generator refuses invalid input/budget | regeneration + hash/byte check |
| materialized skill links | existing package materializer | links resolve the installed package | broken links fail verification | materialization check |

Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0007; no new rule or placement.
Decision Record: Not needed, inherited from D#19384.
Discussion Criteria Mapping: D#19384 delivery contract 5, Engine pin/generated-carrier portion → AC1–AC3.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AC1: manifest, lock and isolated installed package resolve 0.1.29.
- [ ] AC2: AGENTS.md equals neo + neo-agent-brain / maintainer generator output and preserves the existing AiConfig read gate, within its byte budget, and contains the accepted goal-first premise.
- [ ] AC3: existing link checks and appropriate shared baseline checks pass.
- [ ] AC4: PR names source evidence and retains fresh-session loading/replay under Skills #140; this leaf does not close that integration outcome.

## Out of Scope
Brain/Institution consumer updates, new rule text, Atlas semantics, live seat migration and fresh-session replay.

## Avoided Traps
Hand-editing generated copies; pinning the incomplete 0.1.28 source; claiming lockfile or CI proves actual session loading.
